title.narrative: Southwest Area Integrated Water Resources Planning and Management

description.narrative: As overall goal, the Project will enhance economic growth and reduce poverty in the concerned FCD/I areas, while providing a model for rejuvenating the poorly performing FCD/I systems that will be replicated throughout the country. The Project objective is to enhance and sustain the productivity of the selected existing FCD/I systems suffering from low performance and high incidence of poverty, with its scope comprising (i) preparing participatory integrated water management plans (IWMPs) ($0.9 million); (ii) establishing productive and sustainable water management systems through IWMP implementation comprising (a) WMA formation and strengthening with participatory preparation of program implementation plans ($1.5 million), (b) water management infrastructure ($25.3 million), (c) support services for developing agriculture, fishery, and livelihood enhancement of the poor ($3.7 million), and (d) support for establishing sustainable O&M mechanisms ($3.3 million); and (iii) strengthening institutions (including policy and institutional framework and organizational capacities) for effective provision of services to achieve this ends and project management ($7.9 million).

Progress Toward Outcome: a) Overachieved. Cropping Intensity increased to 248%. (As per sample survey of the project area).
b) Overachieved. Annual rice production increased to 3.84 t/ha, (As per sample survey of the project area).
c) Partially achieved. Annual production of cultural fisheries increased to 3,583 t as per DOF and ISPMC field data.
d) Overachieved. Average estimated annual household income of WMG members increased to Tk. 86,400. Data collected from income impact assessment survey for female headed household.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Dec 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/34418/34418-013-34418-023-apfs-en_1.pdf

Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Feb 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/34418/34418-013-smr-en_3.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1(a). Achieved. 4 additional IWMPs have been completed. Bamonkhali-Barnali, Purulia-Charbhatpara and Arol Beel completed, while IWMP of Sunamukhi-Banmander is replaced with FS Tungipara & Kotalipara, which has also been completed and endorsed by BWDB.
1(b). Achieved. 23 additional SIPs have been completed and endorsed by WMAs. The total number of SIPs are 36.
1(c). Achieved. A total of 112,589 (100%) members have enrolled against target of 112,319 (70% of total household no. 159,297). Of these 57,362 (51%) of WMG members are females. 36% of EC members are females and all ECs have six sub-committees with minimum 33% female members.
1(d). Achieved. Target increased from 150 WMGs to 267 WMGs, all of which have been formed and registered. Thus, the total number of WMGs including original project (90 WMGs.) is 357. Agriculture and fisheries programs have been progressed 104% and 75%, respectively. Female participation in collective action is 43%.
1(e). Achieved. 23 nos. O&M transfer agreements have been signed with WMOs. Manuals have been drafted for O&M and for LCS.
2. Achieved. Rehabilitation of 115 works are completed. Overall physical progress is 100% in all implementation schemes.
3(a). Achieved. Institute of Water modelling (IWM) has developed the MIS/Database of SW-AF project. Comments provided during its demonstration are being used to refine the MIS/Database.
3(b). Achieved. A committee setup by the BWDB/MOWR has carried out a need-based assessment and proposed a staffing plan, which has been approved by GOB. A regulation (pravidhanmala) is required to be adopted, following which staffing would be strengthened.
3(c). Achieved. Target increased from 252 WMGs to 367 WMGs, including 90 active WMGs of original project. BWDB through Directorate of Audit (DOA) has conducted audits in 90 WMGs under original project and 203 WMGs under AF project so total comes to 293 no. WMGs. The rest 64 WMGs yet to be audited by DOA under BWDB.
3(d). Achieved. WMO database (sex-disaggregated) published in the project website.
